$about: The stack registry - the ONLY source of official technology best practices (Layer 2). The align router reads this file at the pinned version; a stack not listed here is not official, wherever it lives. Discovery only by design: name, repo, one line - compatibility is declared by each stack repo in its own stack.manifest.json (standards range + the alignable entries), never here, so core releases are never blocked on registry edits. Policy: one stack repo per technology (repository-standards-<technology>); variation is a profile or an adoption mode inside the stack, never a sibling repo; an official stack keeps a named owner and a live boot CI or is delisted.

stacks.description: Node/TypeScript - Next.js + Fastify through one proxy, Better Auth, tiered testing; boot-verified starter
